text:
maria: Quick sync — postmortem action queue from last night's service degradation. I want owners for remediation, ETA, and a clear note to publish to customers. cc @sam @katie
incident-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-04-12-02 — automated capture of logs / alerts attached
sam: I'll take immediate status page update. Will push an interim message in 30m. What's our signal for "resolved" vs "investigating" on the page?
katie: Use "partial service disruption" for now. Keep it brief and avoid technical blamestorming. Example copy below:
```
Intermittent request failures affecting generation endpoints in us-west-2. Engineers are investigating; some customers may see increased latency or errors. We will post updates here and via email to impacted accounts.
```
arjun: For remediation: I'll own the root-cause fix (race in autoscaler backoff) — ETA 2 weeks for PR + canary. Short-term mitigation: tighten scaling threshold (Arjun/Emily) by EOD.
emily: I'll do the short-term mitigation and followup tests. ETA 6 hours.
maria: Thanks. Emily, please add an explicit rollback plan in the PR description and a perf/latency test runbook.
emily: Will do. Also drafting the customer-facing 72h follow-up note; aiming to have a draft for review in 8 hours.
sam: I'll post the interim status page update now and tag impacted accounts. Also agree that the public page should link to a "follow-up pending" note rather than a full RCA yet.
katie: On RCA sharing policy — current recommendation: share a redacted RCA to customers who request within 7 days, full RCA after internal review (14 days). Any objections?
maria: Sounds right. Add a line about redaction: remove internal hostnames, exact user ids, and any PII. Also provide a contact point for customers requesting more detail.
arjun: For recurring incidents — SLO breach pattern looks similar to last quarter's autoscaling flaps. Propose adding this to the monthly reliability themes and scheduling a postmortem pattern review; owner: arjun, due next meeting (7 days).
emily: I'll capture all action items into the incident tracker and assign JIRA tickets. Quick list: Mitigation (emily) 6h; Status page + customer note (sam/emily) 8h; RCA draft (maria/arjun) 7d; Full fix PR (arjun) 14d; Pattern review (arjun) 7d.
maria: Perfect. Add a column for "customer outreach owner" and "share window" in the tracker. Sam, please include a reply template for impacted customers in the tracker.
sam: On it — will add template and send to comms channel for signoff. :thumbsup:
katie: One more — let's make a small FAQ entry on the status page about "what does follow-up mean" so customers know when to expect the RCA. I'll draft that after the customer note is approved.
incident-bot: Action items recorded: 5 items; owners assigned (emily, sam, arjun, maria, katie). Reminders scheduled: 24h and 72h.
maria: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene in 24h to confirm mitigation success and customer messaging. If any delays, post here.
